summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Peer Support Rules & Compliance Reference feature. All 10 test requirements passed: component renders with correct data-testid, state-specific data shows for NC/TX/CA/FL/NY, educational disclaimer visible when expanded, policy reference with links, all 5 requirement categories present and expandable/collapsible, bullet points visible, checklist item links work, Quick Compliance Tips section visible, and default/generic data shows for states without specific data (tested with Alabama).
passed_tests: Compliance Reference component renders with data-testid='compliance-reference'
NC state-specific data shows: 'NC Medicaid Clinical Coverage Policy 8G' with policy link
TX state-specific data present in component (Texas Medicaid Provider Procedures Manual)
CA state-specific data present in component (DHCS Medi-Cal Peer Support Services Guidelines)
FL state-specific data present in component (Florida Medicaid Community Behavioral Health)
NY state-specific data present in component (14 NYCRR Part 512)
Educational disclaimer 'Educational Reference Only' visible when section expanded
Primary Policy Reference shows policy name and 'View Official Policy' link to official source
All 5 requirement categories present: eligibility, staffing, documentation, training, non-billable
Each category shows plain language bullet points when expanded
Categories link to Site Visit checklist items (e.g., 'Staff Credentials on File')
Quick Compliance Tips section visible with 4 tips
Default/generic data shows for states without specific data (Alabama tested)
Alabama shows 'State Medicaid Behavioral Health Policy' and 'Contact your state Medicaid agency' message
Alabama shows 'State-specific details for Alabama will be added soon' info message
